name: Claude Skills Factory Prompt 🏭
description_md:
## What You Get

- Claude Code ready master prompt you can copy-paste to scaffold complete skill folders, SKILL.md, sample_prompt.md, and ZIP packaging for immediate import.

- Includes the uploaded SKILLS_FACTORY_GENERATOR_PROMPT.md so you can import and configure variables directly in Claude Code.

- Configuration variables (BUSINESS_TYPE, USE_CASES, NUMBER_OF_SKILLS, COMPLEXITY_LEVEL, PYTHON_PREFERENCE) that let non-technical users customize at scale.

- Production-ready outputs: kebab-case folder names, fully formatted SKILL.md files, optional Python scripts, and test data when applicable.
